metadata.description:
domain: This is the base domain where your services are available, e.g. example.com. This field is required!
									  use_https: Allows to change from https to http (default: true)
									  port: Allows to change the default metadata port (default: 8070)

orchestrator.description: orchestrator: Set this to "ecs" for getting ELB/Target-group/ECS related metrics or "kubernetes" to get traefik related metrics inside the grafana dashboard
